born.parents: Son of Howard Stark and Maria Stark

story: Born May 29, 1970, in Manhattan, Anthony Edward Stark was the brilliant son of industrialist Howard Stark and Maria Stark, inheriting Stark Industries at age twenty-one.

Ambushed in Afghanistan by the Ten Rings, Stark suffered shrapnel near his heart, constructed the miniature Arc Reactor with Ho Yinsen, forged the Mark I armor, and announced his superhero identity to the world.
Stark co-founded the Avengers, fought Loki and Ultron, catalyzed the Sokovia Accords, guided Peter Parker, and ultimately sacrificed his life utilizing the six Infinity Stones to vanquish Thanos.

born.parents: Son of Joseph Rogers and Sarah Rogers

story: Born July 4, 1918, in Brooklyn, Steven Grant Rogers was the frail, determined son of Irish immigrants Joseph and Sarah Rogers, enduring sickness and loss with unbreakable resolve.

Selected for Project Rebirth by Dr. Abraham Erskine, Steve was transformed by the Super-Soldier Serum into Captain America, leading the Howling Commandos against Red Skull before crashing into Arctic ice.
Awakened seventy years later, Rogers led the Avengers through New York and Sokovia, dismantled Hydra within S.H.I.E.L.D., wielded Mjolnir against Thanos, and chose a quiet lifetime with Peggy Carter.

born.parents: Son of Odin Borson and Frigga

story: Born over a millennium ago in the golden realm of Asgard, Thor Odinson is the mighty firstborn son of Allfather Odin and Queen Frigga, crowned God of Thunder.
Banished to Midgard stripped of divine power, Thor learned humility among mortals, reclaimed enchanted war-hammer Mjolnir, and embraced Earth as his protectorate alongside the nascent Avengers.

Surviving the destruction of Asgard, the loss of his brother Loki, and the trauma of the Snap, Thor forged Stormbreaker, aided the Multiversal defense, and currently journeys raising adopted daughter Love.

born.parents: Son of Brian Banner and Rebecca Banner

story: Born December 18, 1969, in Dayton, Ohio, Robert Bruce Banner was the introverted child of Brian and Rebecca Banner, growing into a renowned nuclear physicist and biochemist.

Attempting to recreate Erskine's Super-Soldier Serum using gamma radiation at Culver University, Banner absorbed a fatal dosage, creating a monstrous green alter-ego triggered by elevated heart rates.
Finding sanctuary among the Avengers, Banner conquered his monstrous rage by synthesizing his scientific intellect with Hulk's raw physiology, utilizing the Nano Gauntlet to reverse the Blip.

story: Born December 3, 1984, in Stalingrad, Natalia Alianovna Romanoff was surrendered as an infant to the clandestine KGB Red Room program, subjected to psychological conditioning and sterilization.
Trained into the Red Room's deadliest assassin, Natasha was spared by Clint Barton and defected to S.H.I.E.L.D., using espionage, martial arts, and undercover tradecraft to expiate past crimes.
Romanoff became the emotional linchpin of the Avengers, exposed Hydra, dismantled General Dreykov's Red Room, and willingly sacrificed her life on Vormir so Clint Barton could claim the Soul Stone.

story: Born June 18, 1971, in Waverly, Iowa, Clinton Francis Barton was raised alongside brother Barney, honing extraordinary kinetic instincts and world-class archery through relentless personal discipline.
Recruited as S.H.I.E.L.D.'s premier marksman, Barton formed an indelible partnership with Natasha Romanoff before becoming a founding member of the Avengers during the Chitauri invasion of Manhattan.
Driven to vigilante vengeance as Ronin following his family's dusting, Barton fought in the Time Heist, defeated Kingpin's syndicate in New York, and mentored Kate Bishop as Hawkeye's successor.
